system.description:
• An operative working the outer ring of the Veiled Ones' growing intelligence network — not a full member, but trained and trusted enough to collect, verify, and pass on information.
  • The Veiled Ones work for The Violet Conclave and are building this network deliberately, using ysoki gatherers and trained agents like you.
  • Your identity is protected; most of what you know about the organisation above you is limited by design.
  • Silent Tail: Advantage on checks to observe, tail, or surveil a target without being noticed. A creature you observed for at least 10 minutes before the fight has Disadvantage on its attacks against you in the first round.
  • Discreet Channels: Advantage on checks to collect, verify, or pass on intelligence discreetly, and on checks establishing a plausible reason for being somewhere you shouldn't be.
